scope: Recorded live public PR failure, Astra-generated repair published to the same open PR, and fresh exact-commit Daytona retest.

review.label: Max
review.message: The Astra commit passed the same seven rollout checks in a fresh Daytona pair.

pullRequest.title: Add a launch board and migrate session identities

fix.summary: Retains the base reader’s flat payload, adds the V2 identity payload, and writes both formats. V2 reads also support sessions inserted by the base release during rollout. Rollback preserves persisted V2 values in the base format before removing the added column. No tests were run; the launch board and release.json identity remain unchanged.
fix.validation: Root and standalone TypeScript passed. 15 immutable native PostgreSQL contract checks passed. Receipt sha256:68d73117db68a99285a4881d7e7a6f9026722ac8133f46a432c86aa8ee28d07a.

limits: Fixed Fieldnotes sample recipe with a deliberate failure. Seven cloud checks cover isolated feature behavior and mixed rollout. Native validation additionally checks rollback. The PR remains open; no merge or arbitrary repository support is implied.
